lines.t: Let go, let go, be broken
Give up the tight-fisted grasp of self
All must pass away
Release, collapse, surrender
conviction brings revelation awakening the soul from sleep repentance grows in salty tears as
the heart turns work begins anew how many times have i held on to fragments built altars on
Shifting sand
I return again and again to die
And find life burgeoning in the grave
Be destroyed in holy love
Crying out, come undone
Withhold nothing
Let the fire purge
For love is a power that remains
Rebirth is found in surrender
Overcome, overcome, you create me anew
You and me and I and you in the refining heat
Where death yields to life
Where the old self bends
And the image restores and stands
Yield, bow down, release the burden pride
Shedding tears as offerings, pursuing purity of heart and mind
I cannot stand before you clothed in self
Unravel me, heal me, teach me to love others as myself
Born again, again, from glory to glory
day after day I die, day after day I rise
trust without condition, obey without expectation
love without measure, rest in the arms of the maker
the healer of every wound, death conquered, life renewed
All creation in his hand
Beneath deception and storm rise
Fragile flower, blossoming, shining
Watered daily by infinite mercy
All is ordered for good
Even the pain that undoes
Do not look behind, run forward
Let purpose fill the empty places
The reason you were crafted
Born to shine, to die daily and until you truly live
Born again, again, from glory to glory
Day after day I die, day after day I rise
Trust without condition, obey without expectation
Love without measure, dying that I might awaken Broken so the beloved man's, let every passion
Every fire be consumed in love Born again, again
Never ending, never beginning I run forward to meet the dawn
Thank you.
Thanks for watching!
